Name: Coop and Barn Facelift Redux
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
The original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874?tab=description]Coop and Barn Facelift[/url] by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nykachu]nykachu [/url]broke long ago with the 1.6 update, but thanks to their open permissions I could update it and bring it back!

Now your coops and barns can be clean, slightly bigger, have cool colors AND have working auto-feeders again. [size=1]Ah, the magic of Content Patcher, Tiled, and ADHD...[/size] So yes, everything from the original mod is here and exactly the same, but there's also [i]more[/i]. What's the 'more', you ask? Well, I decided to recode it so now everything is one single mod and fully configurable!
[line]
[color=#9fc5e8][size=3][b][i]Features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Cleans up all coops and barns[/b], and also increases the interior size by one tile to the right and bottom.
[*]Choose between the [b]'original' and 'clean' versions[/b] in the config menu, instead of downloading different files. [size=1](more in the config section!)[/size]
[*][b]Choose the wall color[/b] of all coops and barns! There are [b]19 options[/b] including vanilla, and you can turn it off if you prefer another recolor mod's walls.
[*]Also lets you [b]choose the wood color[/b], aka the main recolor! It can be set to vanilla, VPR or TD. You can [i]also[/i] turn it off if you are using a different recolor and prefer its wood color/want your coops and barns to match the rest of interiors.
[*][b]Recolors machines/craftables[/b] that only work in a coop/barn to match the VPR or TD wood color you choose. [size=1](more in the config section!)[/size]
[*][b]Map edits can be turned on and off[/b] (default is on, of course). If it's off, you can use it alongside other map replacers and the recolors you set here will apply to them!
[*][b]Includes compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]SVE[/b][/url]'s premium buildings and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054][b]VPP[/b][/url]﻿'s overcrowding talent![/b] Now all your coops and barns will be consistent!
[/list][line]
[color=#9fc5e8][size=3][b][i]Config[/i][/b][/size][/color]
Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to easily choose your options!

[list]
[*][b]Enable Coop/Barn:[/b] enables the changes made to the maps (cleaner + slightly bigger), if it's 'on' this mod is [color=#e06666][b]incompatible[/b] [/color]with other mods that replace the coop/barn vanilla maps.
[*][b]Floor Version:[/b][list]
[*][u]Original[/u]: cleans up everything and increases the maps by one tile to the right and bottom, also keeps the hay on the floor but it's less messy.
[*][u]Clean[/u]: the same as the other one, but without any hay on the floor, so you can see that beautiful [i]fixed[/i] floor!
[/list]
[*][b]Enable wall color:[/b] will override other recolor mods, disable this ONLY if you are using an interior recolor that's not VPR/TD and want to see its wall color instead.
[*][b]Wall color:[/b] vanilla, red, orange, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, pastel pink, cream, chocolate, redwood, bluegray, seagreen, pastel purple, white, gold, rosegold, dark chocolate.
[*][b]Enable wood color:[/b] will override other recolor mods, disable this ONLY if you are using an interior recolor that's not VPR/TD and want to see its wood color instead.
[*][b]Wood color:[/b] vanilla, TD or VPR.
[*][b]Recolor machines:[/b] recolors the hay hopper and incubator to match the wood color chosen (VPR/TD).
[*]I[b]ndividual Recolors section:[/b] recolors the hay, hay bale, auto-grabber, auto-petter and/or ostrich incubator to match the wood color chosen (VPR/TD). You can individually toggle each one on and off.
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] 'Recolor machines' and all toggles under 'Individual Recolors' will only work when 'wood color' is set to either VPR or TD, but they'll do so even if 'enable wood color' is turned off.
[line]
[color=#9fc5e8][size=3][b][i]Compatibility[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b][color=#93c47d]All recolors work![/color][/b] This mod will automatically override them, and you can disable the 'wall color' and/or 'wood color' options if you'd prefer to see your recolor mod's assets instead! It has the extra compat with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url] and [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580762-a-toned-down-stardew-valley-updated]TD[/url], so you can select those in the config instead of disabling the config to get an extra clean map!
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25586][b]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn[/b][/url]﻿﻿﻿[/color]:[/b] [color=#93c47d][b]Compatible![/b][/color] It adds its own maps, so of course it is! Your settings here will also be applied to the Mega buildings.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][b]SVE[/b][/url]﻿:[/b] [color=#93c47d][b]Compatible![/b][/color] This mod includes map replacements for its premium buildings and they will automatically be applied if you have its type (coop/barn) enabled.
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20054][b]VPP[/b][/url]﻿:[/b] [color=#93c47d][b]Compatible![/b][/color] No need to disable the overcrowding edits on their side, this mod will detect when you get the talent and apply the edits itself so they match!
[*][color=#ffe599][b]Mods that change the craftables or hay's appearance[/b][/color] will override the changes this mod makes to them if they're loaded after this one, but won't break anything. Simply disable the changes of the other mod (and vice versa if this mod is the one overriding another one you prefer).
[*][color=#ffe599][b]It works with mods that change the layout[/b][/color], but only if you disable the changes this mod makes to the maps first (so you'd only get the recolors from this).
[/list][line]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=3][i]Uninstalling[/i][/size][/color][/b]
You can freely install this mod at any point, but make sure nothing (chests, machines, furniture etc.) is against the bottom or right wall before you uninstall it, since that could cause them to become inaccessible!
[line]
[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=3][i]Mods in the Pictures[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18769]DSHi Shipping Items Retexture[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3640]Chonkins[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7732]Expressive Elf Ears﻿[/url]﻿
[/list][line]
[b][i][color=#9fc5e8][size=3]Credits[/size][/color][/i][/b]
All credits for the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3874?tab=description]Coop and Barn Facelift[/url] go to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nykachu]nykachu[/url], of course! I'd also really like to thank them for the open permissions that made this update possible and that let so many modders use their wall recolors in their own mods!
[line]
